title: Generating and Evaluating Explanations of Attended and Error-Inducing Input Regions for VQA Models
reasoning: The paper is a technical work in Explainable AI for Visual Question Answering (VQA) models. It focuses on generating and evaluating new types of visual explanations (Error Maps) to help users understand model performance. The content does not involve any analysis, evaluation, or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics.
